body:
TranscendPlexity generates verified deterministic Python solve() functions for ARC tasks offline. Zero LLM calls at inference.

**Results:**
- ARC-AGI-1: 400/400 (100%)
- ARC-AGI-2 test: 102/240 (42.5%) with 100% accuracy on targeted tasks
- 13 "Impossible" tasks solved (0% solve rate everywhere else)
- ARC-AGI-3: FT09 WIN (6/6 levels), VC33 WIN (7/7 levels)
- Inference cost: $0

**Method:** Claude proposes solve(grid) → verified against training examples → only 100%-passing programs committed.

**Open Source:**
- Solvers (MIT): https://github.com/GitMonsters/SOLVED-540-of-540
- 13 Impossible: https://github.com/GitMonsters/13-Impossible-ARC-Tasks-SOLVED

**Notebooks:**
- ARC-AGI-2: https://www.kaggle.com/code/evanpieser/arc-prize-2026-arc-agi-2-transcendplexity
- ARC-AGI-3: https://www.kaggle.com/code/evanpieser/arc-prize-2026-arc-agi-3-starter
- Paper + visualizations: https://www.kaggle.com/code/evanpieser/transcendplexity-arc-prize-2026-paper
